text:
Skerrow Bank wind farm now stands at 72 turbines, according to a project update released Tuesday by Northshore Renewables. The company said the array, sited 18 miles off the coast near Gannet Point, has reached full mechanical completion after a nine-month install campaign. Total nameplate capacity is 1.08 gigawatts, with first power already flowing to the grid under a 20-year offtake deal.

Northshore said commissioning will finish in April, with commercial operations expected in early summer. The build employed 1,400 workers at peak and came in 4% under budget, helped by calmer-than-forecast winter seas.

For the sector, Skerrow Bank is another sign that large-scale offshore projects are moving from headline announcements to delivery, even as supply-chain costs remain elevated.
